name: Environment Southland Biodiversity Community Group Grant
summary: Grants for volunteer-led conservation projects in Southland, covering fencing of native bush, pest plant and animal control and restoration planting; funds up to 70% of project costs.

amount.note: Per project per year; grants can be one-off or multi-year

calls.label: Annual round
calls.recurring: Opens 1 July and closes 1 May each year; funds must be spent by 30 June of the funding year

status.quote: Applications close on 1st May each year, and funds must be spent by 30th June of the funding year.

recurring.quote: The next round of applications open on 1 July. Applications close on 1st May each year, and funds must be spent by 30th June of the funding year.

applicant_types.quote: This grant is open to volunteer community groups, not-for-profit organisations, and rūnaka, iwi, and other indigenous groups.

geography.quote: Projects must be based in Southland.

access.quote: Click here for the application form

window.quote: Applications close on 1st May each year, and funds must be spent by 30th June of the funding year.

amount.quote: Funding is available for up to $10,000 per project per year. Grants can be one-off or part of a multi-year initiative.

co_finance_required.quote: Funding can cover up to 70% of total project costs, with the remainder sourced elsewhere.
